items.title: Gresham House Energy Storage puts itself up for sale after activist pressure
items.summary: Gresham House Energy Storage has decided to seek a sale following shareholder discussions and pressure regarding the timing of returns.

items.title: Ardonagh appoints Mallory Motley head of international placement
items.summary: Ardonagh has named former Marsh managing director Mallory Motley as head of international placement, adding insurer-advisory expertise to its group placement team.

items.title: Just Group returns to Just Retirement brand name
items.summary: Just Group is bringing back the Just Retirement trading name to highlight its core focus on UK pension risk transfer and retail retirement solutions.

items.title: Paul Upton features on latest Insurance Age Double Indemnity podcast
items.summary: Brookhurst Advisory principal Paul Upton discusses his industry career, the collapse of Independent Insurance, and cofounding Evolution Underwriting.

items.title: Liberty Specialty Markets names Richard Richards to lead London property D&F
items.summary: Liberty Specialty Markets has appointed former Chaucer underwriter Richard Richards to lead its London property direct and facultative business.

items.title: Government launches consultations on default retirement income for private sector DC savers
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions has published consultations on Guided Retirement and Retirement Collective Pension Schemes to give private sector workers a default income option.
